cacheable_unit: ONE VALIDATED MARKET BUNDLE = sealed package + declared build dependencies + builder version + shared runtime/template inputs + toolchain identity + build options -> BUILD_INPUT_KEY; output = bundle bytes (site/) + OUTPUT_BUNDLE_DIGEST (assemble_production_site.bundle_digest) + bundle validation receipt

storage.objects: objects/<bundle sha256>.zip -- deterministic archive, never overwritten under its digest
storage.index: index/<build input key>.json -- one row per key
storage.quarantine: quarantine/ -- damaged rows and objects moved aside

trusted_publication_requires: archive round-trips to the built digest before anything is visible
no repository file read outside the declared closure (open()/open_code tracer)
determinism: a second cold build with an identical digest
no evidence older than 365 days, every capture dated
receipt written and bound to key + digest + policy + dependency digests
publication order: archive, receipt, then the index row (atomic renames)
lookup_rule: requested key == stored key (one index row per key)
archive present, non-empty, recorded size and archive sha
receipt binds key, digest, TRUSTED, builder/assembler/runtime/closure/render digests, python version
receipt policy == current (compatible older policy => REVALIDATE, incompatible => miss)
no referenced artifact revoked; earliest evidence expiry in the future; entry not revoked
boundaries: a hit is artifact identity, never release authorization (no eligibility field exists on an entry or bundle receipt)
the production assembler, generator and deployer do not import the cache
the live and rollback releases are never only in this cache; gc_plan() is a dry run
